<h1>Chord Clock Division</h1>

## Purpose

Set each sequencer's independent **chord-progression advance rate**: how
fast it walks through the 16-bar chord grid, independent of its note clock
division. Rates 1–4 keep the chord stable within each bar; rates 5–8
advance the chord *within* a bar (chord-arpeggiation effects).

## Interaction

A per-sequencer rate selector: one row per sequencer, the pressed column
(1–8) is the rate. Rate meanings: 1 = every ~8 bars, 2 = every 4 bars,
3 = every 2 bars, 4 = every bar (default), 5 = every half bar, 6 = every
quarter bar, 7 = every 2 steps, 8 = every step. Both LPs stay in sync via
shared LED feedback.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press column N (1–8) | LP grid | Set that sequencer's chord advance rate to N | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE / SHIFT + SOLO | LP grid | **No-op**: deliberately excluded from reset/randomise (single-value view) | any |
